form.label: Your answer
form.div: Answers are case-insensitive. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.

search.query: index=scoreboard ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Team="$ctf_Team$" NOT Result=Hint | stats count as Attempts max(BasePointsAwarded) as BasePointsEarned max(SpeedBonusAwarded) as BonusPointsEarned sum(Penalty) as PenaltyPoints count(eval(Result=="Incorrect")) as IncorrectAttempts count(eval(Result=="Correct")) as CorrectAttempts by Number | append [ | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval Attempts=0, IncorrectAttempts=0, CorrectAttempts=0 | fields Number BasePoints Attempts CorrectAttempts IncorrectAttempts ] | stats last(BasePoints) as BasePointsAvailable max(BasePointsEarned) as BasePointsEarned max(BonusPointsEarned) as BonusPointsEarned sum(PenaltyPoints) as PenaltyPoints sum(Attempts) as Attempts sum(IncorrectAttempts) as IncorrectAttempts sum(CorrectAttempts) as CorrectAttempts by Number | eval Status=case( CorrectAttempts>0,"Correct", IncorrectAttempts>0,"Incorrect", true(),"Unanswered") | fillnull value=0 BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned PenaltyPoints Attempts | fields Number Status Attempts BasePointsAvailable BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned PenaltyPoints | rename BasePointsAvailable as "Base Points" BasePointsEarned as "Base Earned" BonusPointsEarned as "Speed Bonus" PenaltyPoints as "Penalty" | search Number="$Number$"

html.div: Select a hint to purchase it. If no rows are shown, this question has no hints.

search.query: | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Number="$Number$" | eval Attempts=0 | fields ctf_id Number | gethints | stats values(Hints) as Hints by ctf_id Number | mvexpand Hints | spath input=Hints | fields ctf_id Number HintNumber HintCost Hint | sort 0 + HintNumber | rename HintCost as "Cost" Hint as "Hint" | search Hint=*
